definition: a game played by dealing out a deck
description: Three young friends play cards at a table on a moving train, fields passing outside the window. A young woman with long dark hair, in a mustard top and wide jeans, throws one arm up in triumph and laughs, then puts her hand back on the table. Across from her a young man in a navy shirt holds a fan of cards and rolls his eyes up. A young woman with a red ponytail, in a green T-shirt, stands at the table holding her cards. Paper coffee cups and a pile of cards sit on the table, and a brown and white spaniel lies underneath.

taps.phrase: to raise her arm in triumph
